mechanics: Half-HP threshold: 'if your current hit point value is half your maximum or less' gates bonuses + XP 1 (Strength in Agony, Cauterize, Growing Rage, Reckless Offensive, Into the Fight, Inner Fire, Seeing Red, Bone Breaker, Spiked Armor) and damage reduction (Numb the Pain)

Optional self-damage as a cost: 'You may suffer damage 2 to ...' (Defiance of Death, Cauterize, Dazing Wound, Into the Fight, Seeing Red, Fueled by Pain, Spiked Armor, Burning Hatred); variable 'suffer up to N' with X = damage chosen (Strength in Agony 3, Flurry of Axes 4)

Mandatory self-damage / HP setting in '!' boxes: Blood Pact (half current HP; 1 per turn persistent), Glass Hammer (set HP to 1), Burning Hatred (damage 1 that cannot be negated); From the Brink sets HP to half max

X values from HP or damage: Attack X = current HP (Glass Hammer), XP per 5 damage dealt (Glass Hammer), Heal X = damage dealt by the attack (Fueled by Pain), Attack +X = hexes moved in a straight line (Careless Charge), Retaliate X = adjacent enemies (Careless Charge)
Damage negation: next damage that would drop you below 1 (Defiance of Death), next damage this round (Spiked Armor), -1 damage per source this round at half HP (Numb the Pain)
'Gain XP 1 the next time you retaliate this round' (Resolute Stand, Unbridled Power, Tireless Retribution)
Retaliate-triggered effects: Heal 1 on each retaliate (Growing Rage), Wound on enemies damaged by your retaliate (Spiked Armor)
Damage-taken triggers: Attack 4 after each of the next six damage sources while adjacent to an enemy (Vengeful Barrage), damage 1 to all Wounded enemies whenever you suffer damage (Bathe in Blood)
Advantage on your attacks / disadvantage on attacks targeting you this round (Shiny Distraction, Tireless Retribution); Attack 5 with advantage at end of turn for 4 turns (Final Fight)
Final Fight: you become exhausted when the card moves from the active area to the lost pile
Short rest gives the benefits of a long rest (Tireless Retribution)
Repeatable action with escalating self-damage (Burning Hatred bottom)

Targeting: enemies moved through that have Wound (Fueled by Pain), all enemies within 3 hexes (Flurry of Axes), consume Fire to extend melee targets to 'up to two hexes away' (Unbridled Power, Seeing Red, Burning Hatred), splash on enemies adjacent to the target but not to you (Unstoppable Destruction)
Character token placed on an enemy, which loses Flying (Bone Breaker, persistent)
Self-inflicted Wound as a cost (Careless Charge); recover a lost card at exactly 1 HP (From the Brink)
Fire is the only element (infuse and consume); conditions used: Wound, Immobilize, Stun, Muddle, Strengthen; no summons

Corner icons: single card with red X = lost (same icon the Bruiser sheet reads as lost; the mat's LOST pile shows it); card stack with red X = unrecoverable (Flurry of Axes top, Burning Hatred bottom, both also lost). Every corner box has a '!' tab
unclear: Bone Breaker bottom: persistent with no use slots and no lost icon; when the character-token effect ends (target dies? end of scenario?) is a rules question, not a reading one

Vengeful Barrage / Final Fight: XP icons sit at the top-right of slots, read as slots 2, 4, 6 (Vengeful Barrage) and 2, 3, 4 (Final Fight); on the two-row Vengeful track the icon between slots could in principle belong to the next slot (I read it like the Bruiser convention: top-right of the slot it belongs to)
Into the Fight bottom: the Fire icon inside the text has no consume X, so I read it as 'infuse Fire'
